tables.name: Leadership Unity
tables.description: Whether those in charge present a unified front. For a single leader, that person and those close to them in ruling.

results.name: Rank Animosity
results.description: There is open and blatant hostility. Outbursts, threats, and physical violence are possible (or, even, common).

results.name: Thinly-Veiled Discord
results.description: There is barely disguised hostility. Muttering, sarcasm, and spiteful comments are likely, but blatant actions, such as yelling or violence, has not occurred.

results.name: Strained
results.description: Tension can be felt in the room, and overly polite disagreements are frequent.

results.name: Uneasy
results.description: Something feels off, but it may just be that someone is having a bad day.

results.name: Close-Knit
results.description: Communication is open. Disagreements are constructive.

results.name: Accord
results.description: Most of those involved are on the same wavelength, and can often anticipate one another.

results.name: United
results.description: The bond between those in power is pretty ironclad. They are all of one mind, wholly and equally committed to one vision.
